newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis values firmed on Friday as dealers noted scant farm sales and the selloff of Chicago Board of Trade grain prices.
"The board came down, farmers are doing fieldwork and there is a lack of interior movement," one U.S. exporter said.

Also, the U.S. Coast Guard on Friday tightened restrictions on barge traffic on the flood-swollen Mississippi River following an accident involving two chemical barges, officials said. Maritime traffic has been sharply curtailed on the Mississippi since mid-March, when heavy spring rains sent floodwaters racing downriver.
